variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Styles/font-style-skinny
variables.description: Ultra‑light strokes with high elegance and airiness. Best for large display headings, hero text, and subtle UI chrome—avoid small sizes to maintain legibility.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Styles/font-style-normal
variables.description: Clean, balanced stroke weight with upright posture. Ideal for body copy, paragraphs, and long-form content where readability is paramount.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 48-72/large-spacious
variables.description: Maximal display leading; event posters, brand moments, or layouts needing dramatic separation.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 48-72/large-comfortable
variables.description: Hero headlines meant to be read, not just scanned; generous breathing room.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 48-72/large-cozy
variables.description: Default for large display text; readable at two lines with comfortable rhythm.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 48-72/large-snug
variables.description: Primary headlines with confident density; allows controlled two-line wraps.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 48-72/large-compact
variables.description: Display headlines in tight, editorial stacks; minimizes scroll while preserving impact. Single-line preferred.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 20-36/medium-spacious
variables.description: Hero subheads or display labels; creates clear separation from surrounding content.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 20-36/medium-comfortable
variables.description: Multi-line lead paragraphs and marketing subheads; supports relaxed reading flow.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 20-36/medium-cozy
variables.description: Default for medium headings and short paragraphs; balances presence and readability.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 20-36/medium-snug
variables.description: Strong, compact headings and navigation items; good for one or two lines with controlled wrap.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-xs
variables.description: Use for small text in compact interfaces, helper text, metadata, micro labels, and secondary UI information.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 10-16/small-cozy
variables.description: Default for small body/captions when multi-line is possible; maintains legibility without wasted vertical space.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-family-modern
variables.description: A modern serif introduced for newspaper and magazine headlines that combines elegance and sophistication with modern proportions. Ideal for economical typesetting both on paper and screen.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 10-16/small-snug
variables.description: Dense single-line controls and short captions; suitable for truncated text, icon+label buttons, and compact toolbars.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-family-elegant
variables.description: A distressed typeface with expressive calligraphic influences from Eastern Europe. Offers a unique blend of vintage and artistic charm, mixing swash stylistic sets with regular styles.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-sans
variables.description: A modern geometric sans serif that's both functional and visually engaging for a broad array of design projects. Its clear lines and ten weights, ranging from Thin to Black, make it versatile and expressive.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Letter Spacing/letter-spacing-stretched
variables.description: Strongly open tracking for display, hero labels, or wide letterforms that need presence. Adds elegance and air but can slow reading; use on short headlines or decorative typographic moments.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-lg
variables.description: Use for large text, section headers, prominent labels, and short emphasis statements. Suitable for mid-level hierarchy.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-script-cursive-fallback
variables.description: A Script font mimicking cursive or calligraphic handwriting, often flowing and elegant. Used in wedding invitations, boutique branding, and decorative headings.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 10-16/small-compact
variables.description: Extremely tight leading intended for single-line UI labels only (chips, table headers). Avoid multi-line; will clip ascenders/descenders at small sizes.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-slab-fallback
variables.description: Slab fonts are ideal for bold, eye-catching design. They shine in advertising, editorial layouts, and logos where strength and clarity are key.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-7xl
variables.description: Reserved for impactful and minimal text.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-4xl
variables.description: Use for extra-large display text, landing page hero lines, and major brand statements. Not recommended for long text.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-3xl
variables.description: Use for large display text, prominent hero areas, or visually strong typographic hierarchy.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-mono-fallback
variables.description: Monospace fonts are perfect for technical and minimalist design. Common in programming interfaces, terminal UIs, and data-driven visualizations.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-sm
variables.description: Use for small body text, secondary descriptions, and tighter UI layouts. Often paired with compact spacing patterns.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-xl
variables.description: Use for small display text, subheadings, and section titles. Works well for major UI anchors and content headers.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Letter Spacing/letter-spacing-expanded
variables.description: Mildly open tracking that aids clarity in small sizes, low-contrast themes, or all‑caps labels. Useful for secondary navigation, data tables, and metadata to reduce crowding.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Letter Spacing/letter-spacing-collapsed
variables.description: Very tight tracking for dense, all‑caps micro labels, badges, or compact nav items. Increases cohesion but risks merging letterforms; reserve for short strings and high-resolution displays.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-md
variables.description: Use for standard body text. This is the primary reading size for paragraphs, forms, lists, and general content.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-family-futuristic
variables.description: A futuristic geometric typeface with octagonal outlines and rectangular counters. Its high x-height and aligned ascenders allow for compact typesetting, maintaining readability even with retained diagonals. Perfect for tech-inspired designs looking for a modern edge.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-2xl
variables.description: Use for medium display text, hero subtitles, or marketing layouts needing a bold typographic presence.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-mono
variables.description: Characterized by its calm yet stiff appearance and humanistic style that offers balance for digital environments. Ideal for coding ad tabular layouts.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-family-playful
variables.description: A visually bold, brush-script font with heavy drips and numerous alternate glyphs. Embodies a playful, expressive style rooted in its handcrafted design process.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-family-casual
variables.description: Combines playfulness and vintage flair, echoing the hand-lettered styles of mid-20th-century ads. This monolinear, lively font captures a sincere, wacky vibe with open curves and even spacing.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Letter Spacing/letter-spacing-standard
variables.description: Default tracking matching the typeface’s intended spacing. Use for body copy, forms, and most UI text to maintain natural rhythm and legibility across sizes.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-script-cursive
variables.description: An informal script typeface that offers a warm, expressive style with a playful touch. Ideal for casual, personal designs with its relatable, human feel.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-family-display
variables.description: A monospaced, geometric sans serif typeface featuring a blend of stiff structure and playful vibes. Its constructivist appeal and OpenType features make it ideal for expressive, large-scale web typography.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-family-decorative
variables.description: Capturing the charm of vintage aesthetics with its expressive, artistic flair, its light and fluid strokes embody a sense of hope and renewal. Perfect for projects seeking a handcrafted, personal touch.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-script-handwritten-fallback
variables.description: A Script font mimicking printed handwriting, perfect for personal and expressive design. Used in party invites, informal branding, and creative packaging.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Styles/font-style-accentuated
variables.description: Soft weight with gentle slant for tonal emphasis. Use for secondary highlights, quotes, captions, and nuanced emphasis that shouldn’t overpower the layout.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Styles/font-style-stressed
variables.description: Strong weight plus directional slant for urgent emphasis. Reserve for high‑priority notices, active states, dynamic subheads, and expressive pull quotes.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Letter Spacing/letter-spacing-condensed
variables.description: Slightly tightened tracking for headings and buttons where space is limited. Improves visual weight without harming readability; avoid on long paragraphs or small text.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-sans-fallback
variables.description: Sans Serif fonts are ideal for clean, readable, and modern designs. They work well in websites, apps, and contemporary branding.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-5xl
variables.description: Use for oversized hero typography, impactful headlines, and expressive brand moments. Ideal for high-emphasis messages.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-serif-fallback
variables.description: Sans Serif fonts are ideal for clean, readable, and modern designs. They work well in websites, apps, and contemporary branding.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-slab
variables.description: Slab fonts are ideal for bold, eye-catching design. They shine in advertising, editorial layouts, and logos where strength and clarity are key.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Base Typescale/font-2xs
variables.description: Use for micro text, badge labels, tiny UI annotations, or dense data displays where space is extremely limited.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 10-16/small-spacious
variables.description: Airy small headings or caption blocks in low-density layouts; use to separate stacked meta lines.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 10-16/small-comfortable
variables.description: Readable multi-line small copy (help text, secondary descriptions) with improved scanability and fewer collisions.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Styles/font-style-emphasized
variables.description: Heavy stroke weight for clear prominence. Apply to headings, key labels, buttons, and calls‑to‑action to establish hierarchy and quick scannability.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-family-vintage
variables.description: A didone serif font with a rugged, distressed vibe, serving architecture sketches and student posters. Ideal for adding character to projects that want to stand out with a classic edge.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Line Heights/Font Sizes 20-36/medium-compact
variables.description: Tight single-line titles in dense lists/cards; use where vertical rhythm must stay minimal.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Library/font-serif
variables.description: Ideal for print, featuring minimalistic wedge serifs and terminals. Excels in simple, strong text settings, leaving an unassuming yet elegant imprint.

variables.name: Typography/Primitives/Font Styles/font-style-chunky
variables.description: Maximal weight for dramatic impact. Use sparingly for short display headlines, logos, numeric counters, and hero statements; avoid dense paragraphs due to visual heaviness.
